messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy finished (canary->prod) for release v2.14. Running postdeploy smoke: synth-kv-prefill & heartbeat probes. First check in 30s. (runbook: https://go/runbooks/postdeploy-smoke)

jess: Seeing a single-step p95 jump on kv-prefill in eu-west: baseline ~160ms -> 420ms (sample window 5m). Not seeing 5xxs.

kevin: can you paste the probe output? logs?

jess: ```json
{"probe":"kv-prefill","p50":85,"p95":420,"errors":0,"fanout":8}
```

alice: console shows no error-rate increase, but queue latency for prefill workers up ~30ms.

sam: p95 420ms is above our fast-smoke threshold (400). Suggest hold and run an expanded sample (fanout=2 -> 20?) to verify if it's systemic.

kevin: I think we should rerun with reduced fanout to isolate. Fanout 8 -> 2 to check tail. Running: `./scripts/run_probe --name=kv-prefill --fanout=2 --window=120` — kicking it now

maria: started run at 1767899050. tagging ops: @alice @jess

deploy-bot: Re-run results: p95=170ms, p99=520ms (very few samples), errors=0. Link: https://console.metrics/probe/1767899012

jess: okay interesting — short-run p95 back to normal but p99 high. Could be a noisy host. Can we identify host ids?

alice: host ids from trace: host-gtx-11, host-gtx-14 showed >400ms on tail. Both in same AZ.

sam: leaning not to rollback. Proposed actions: 1) hold rollout for 20m; 2) mark hosts for investigation and remove from rotation if next re-run shows tail; 3) notify SRE

kevin: +1. I can drain host-gtx-11/14 from canary pool. Doing drain now: `./infra/drain host-gtx-11 host-gtx-14`

oncall-bot: Host drain in progress. ETA 2m.

maria: after drain, re-running full smoke (fanout=8) — started 1767899200

deploy-bot: Full smoke complete: p95=165ms, p99=220ms, errors=0. All probes green. Rolling rollout resumes.

sam: resume approved, unhold after 20m. Add incident note: noisy-hosts causing temporary p99 blips, no rollback.

jess: filing follow-up ticket for host flakiness: INF-2319. Assigning to ops.

kevin: thanks all. closing thread.
